name: Reference states
description: Independent reference states for calibrating orbit uncertainty: precise orbits read from SP3 (files/orbit-products) become GCRF/UTC states per catalogued object, with the product's stated accuracy as covariance and its provenance.

sequentialJustification.detail: Deterministic transform of caller-supplied precise-orbit states and Earth orientation. No host calls, threads, propagation or network access.

inputPorts.description: $OEM from files/orbit-products read_container of one SP3 file: one block per satellite, Earth-fixed (ITRF realization), in the file's time system, positions with SP3 standard-deviation exponents.
$NCD from the same read_container call: the SP3 header (agency, coordinate system, base, per-satellite accuracy) and the file's SHA-256.
$EOP rows bracketing the file's span (one row, several frames, or a size-prefixed stream), as foundation/frames reads them.

wildcardJustification.detail: Which catalogued object each SP3 satellite id is over the file's span, the product name and source, and an optional stated product accuracy.

inputPorts.description: JSON {"product": name, "source": url, "statedSigmaM": optional product accuracy (m) with "statedSigmaBasis", "satellites": {"G01": {"norad": 50, "objectId": "1990-...", "name": ...}}}: which catalogued object each SP3 satellite id is over this file's span.

outputPorts.description: One $OEM per identified satellite: GCRF states in UTC, velocity from the degree-9 Lagrange interpolant of the positions, covariance from the stated accuracy, provenance in COMMENT.
